REPAIR ROUND (2026-09-29): the prior two-mount fwd(64)/aft(48) abstraction (each mixing HHQ-9B/HHQ-16/YJ-18/YJ-20/CY-5-Yu-8) has been replaced with two SAM-type-specific mounts: hhq9b_vls_sam (48, listed first) and hhq16_vls_sam (16 quad-packed, listed second). Runtime fact verified by the coordinator in the engine's weapon-release service: select_ready_vls_mount fires the FIRST vls_sam mount with available rounds and no cooldown, and target_domain is stored but NEVER READ -- so (a) every cell counted in either old mount was mechanically an air-defense interceptor at runtime regardless of the missile it represented, overstating the ship's true SAM inventory by also counting ASCM/ASBM/ASW-rocket cells, and (b) only the first-listed mount is ever reachable while it holds rounds. Per the coordinator's explicit instruction to 'consider one mount per SAM type with its own range and speed,' this record now gives each SAM type its own mount with its own sourced range/speed (HHQ-9B: ~80-90nm/Mach 4.2; HHQ-16: 40nm-upper-bound/850 m/s) rather than sharing one blended value. OPEN ISSUE for the final report: since only the first-listed mount (hhq9b_vls_sam) is ever selected while it has ready rounds, hhq16_vls_sam is functionally unreachable in the current engine unless hhq9b_vls_sam is empty or on cooldown -- this is a known engine limitation flagged per the coordinator's own instruction, not resolved unilaterally by dropping the second mount.

YJ-18A/YJ-20/CY-5-Yu-8/Yu-7 have no NavalWeaponType mount and are listed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory with status content_only_no_mechanism, per the authoring standard's mechanism-gap rule. HHQ-9B and HHQ-16 ARE modeled as documentation-only Missile records referenced from weapon_inventory even though their VLS behavior is abstracted into the SAM-type-specific vls_sam mounts above (per the task's requirement that mount-mapped weapons still get full Missile records).

VLS cell split: 112 total cells = 64 SAM rounds (48 HHQ-9B + 16 quad-packed HHQ-16 in 4 cells) + 16 YJ-18A + 8 YJ-20 + 8 CY-5/Yu-8 (content-only, = 96 of 112 cells accounted for; remaining headroom is engineering-estimate per OOB, actual PLAN loadouts are never published). 12 Yu-7 torpedoes are tube-launched, separate from VLS.

Gun designation conflict (H/PJ-45 vs H/PJ-38) recorded verbatim per the OOB's own instruction to 'use 130mm single' rather than picking a designation; naming used in damage_model.hitboxes.components is generic ('130mm_single_gun').
CIWS mount designation conflict (Type 1130 vs Type 730) recorded verbatim; count of 1 gun-CIWS mount plus 1 HHQ-10 missile-CIWS mount is not disputed across sources.

4-hitbox zoning (fwd VLS/gun/bow-sonar, radar/command/HHQ-10, aft VLS/engineering/fuel, hangar/flight-deck/gun-CIWS/torpedo-tubes/towed-array) follows the DDG-51 template's pattern, adapted for the Type 055's fwd+aft VLS split and larger sensor mast.
